units.source_text: 七段下黑107，用时一小时零三分。

en.t: The seventh-dan player made Black 107, taking one hour and three minutes.

units.source_text: 黑101打入右下方的白模样，这一手是先手十四五目；

en.t: Black 101 invaded White's framework in the lower right; this move was sente and worth fourteen or fifteen points.

units.source_text: 黑107在左下角扩大地盘，这一手是后手二十目左右，

en.t: Black 107 expanded Black's territory in the lower left corner; this move was gote and worth about twenty points,

units.source_text: 这两手大得其益的都是黑子。

en.t: and in both of these large moves it was Black who gained the benefit.
This was plain for everyone to see.
Black was still playing more smoothly.
